name: loom-work-boundary

contracts.description: Binding-layer properties of the taskstore SQLite store that preserve audit and replay fidelity at the loom/taskstore boundary. These are persistence-layer obligations — not pure-core behavior — so they live here, not in taskstore-core.

goals: Every successful mutation is permanently traceable: replay fidelity across sessions, audit without re-interrogating the database.
exclusions: Core command/result semantics: those live in spec/taskstore-core.
File naming, actor format, timestamp source: binding surface, not contract.
Interactions written by a failed (ok:false) command: a command that changed nothing leaves no interaction.
Dedup: whether a duplicate create (linkage idempotency) or a no-op link/unlink appends an entry is binding surface.

title: Passive interactions.jsonl alongside store.export.jsonl
body:
The SQLite binding MUST write a passive interactions.jsonl file alongside store.export.jsonl (same directory, same base name, .interactions.jsonl suffix) and append to it on every successful mutation.

Each appended line is a UTF-8 JSON object with at minimum: at (ISO 8601 timestamp from the command), actor (string from the command), op (the command's op field), task_id (the primary affected task id, or null for ops without a single target), and diff (an object recording field-level changes as {old, new} pairs).

The file is append-only — existing lines are never modified or removed. A fresh store has no interactions.jsonl until its first successful mutation.

Failed commands (result.ok === false) MUST NOT append an entry: an interaction without a corresponding state change is a lie.

Idempotent no-ops that leave state unchanged (a duplicate create returning created:false, a link whose edge already exists returning linked:false, an unlink that found no edge returning removed:false) MUST NOT append an entry for the same reason.

The diff object for a task mutation SHOULD record every field whose value changed between the pre-command and post-command state as {old: <before>, new: <after>}, using null for absent optionals. For ops that do not modify task fields directly (delete, import) the diff MAY be empty.

The interactions.jsonl is a passive observation of the command stream — it is not the authoritative store (the SQLite database is). It is never read by the core and does not affect command results. Its purpose is audit, replay, and migration fidelity at the loom/taskstore boundary.
